blurb: Avondale, one of Arizona’s largest indoor multi-sport facilities, is proud to partner with the City of Avondale to enhance community engagement through sports and recreation. Our facility boasts six state-of-the-art volleyball courts, four basketball courts, two indoor soccer fields, and a versatile 4,000-square-foot multi-purpose room.
